Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied basic chemistry by treating atomic mass as the sum of protons and electrons instead of protons and neutrons. This led to calculating 12 (6 + 6) and ignoring the 7 neutrons, resulting in an incorrect conclusion. The correct mass number is 6 + 7 = 13 (option C), and the Planner also incorrectly labeled option C as “12.”
